intent: Hold the attachment's preview, either a file-type icon on a filled square plate or an image thumbnail.
typical_uses: A file-type icon beside the file's name
A thumbnail of an attached image

dont_use_when.situation: A person's or entity's picture with a fallback

invariants.text: The plate is a square sized from the ancestor Attachment's classes, not from props: 2.5rem wide at the default size, 2rem at `size="sm"` and 1.75rem at `size="xs"`; with `orientation="vertical"` it spans the card's width at the default size only, since the sm and xs widths win over it. Any descendant svg ignores the pointer and is sized to var(--icon-size-sm), var(--icon-size-lg) in the vertical orientation and var(--icon-size-xs) at `xs`, which wins over the vertical size.

With `variant="image"` any descendant img is drawn square at the plate's full width with `object-fit: cover`, and the plate is dimmed to 60% opacity unless the ancestor Attachment's `state` is `done` or `idle`.
An explicit `variant={null}` renders the `icon` variant, in both the class and the `data-variant` attribute.

anti_patterns.dont: Put an img in AttachmentMedia without `variant="image"`
anti_patterns.do_instead: Set `variant="image"` so the image is cropped square and fills the plate

good.title: An image thumbnail on a vertical card

bad.title: A size prop on the media
bad.why: AttachmentMedia declares no `size` and its div surface has none, so TypeScript rejects it; the plate takes its size from the ancestor Attachment's `size`.

companions.typed_by: cva(...), returns (props: VariantProps<typeof attachmentMediaVariants> & { className?: string }) => string
companions.description: The class-name builder AttachmentMedia uses for its base and `variant` classes; it does not set the `data-variant` attribute the component renders, and a `null` variant yields no variant class.
